grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Herald of the Fall
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: If a Unit that only includes Models with the Midnight Sorrow Trait is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Herald of the Fall. All Models in the Unit gain the Fear (1) Special Rule. When the last Model in the Unit is Removed as a Casualty, every enemy Unit with at least one Model within 12" of that Model must make a Leadership Check. Any Unit that fails this Check gains the Routed Tactical Status.

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Death's Promise
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: If a Unit that only includes Models with the Dreaming Shadow Trait and the Infantry or Cavalry Type is selected to fill a Prime Force Organisation Slot, the following Prime Advantage can be selected: Death's Promise. All Models in the Unit gain the Eternal Warrior (1) Special Rule. If a Model already has a variant of the Eternal Warrior (X) Special Rule, increase its value of X by 1 instead, to a maximum of Eternal Warrior (2).

grantedPrimeAdvantages.name: Prismatic Master
grantedPrimeAdvantages.text: The Model for which this Prime Advantage was selected has its Base Ballistic Skill Characteristic changed to 6, and its Prismatic Cannons (including a Twin Prismatic Cannon) gain the Pinning (1) Special Rule in every mode.
grantedPrimeAdvantages.note: Must be selected for the Prime Slot of the Weaver Constellation Apex Detachment.
